parameters.content:
## Sales Quotation & Approval Management System

### How it works

This workflow receives sales quotation requests through a form, validates the submitted data, and looks up product pricing from Google Sheets. It calculates quotation values, checks discount and profit-margin policy, then either auto-approves the quotation or sends it to a manager for approval. Approved, rejected, and error outcomes are prepared, logged where applicable, and sent by Gmail to the customer or sales executive.

### Setup steps

- Configure the form trigger fields for customer details, product identifier, quantity, discount, and any other quotation inputs expected by the validation code.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and point the product lookup node to the product price sheet with matching product IDs/SKUs and pricing columns.
- Configure Google Sheets logging nodes to write approved, manager-approved, and rejected quotation records to the correct quotation log sheets.
- Connect Gmail credentials for customer notifications, manager approval requests, and sales-executive rejection notices.
- Update the workflow configuration node with the maximum auto-discount, minimum profit margin, default quotation status, and manager email address.
- Review the custom code nodes to ensure validation, calculation, and pricing-policy logic match the organization’s quoting rules.

### Customization

Adjust approval thresholds, manager routing, email templates, spreadsheet column mappings, and error-response messages to fit different sales policies or product catalogs.

## Capture and validate request

Starts the workflow from the quotation form, applies global quotation settings, validates the submitted data, and routes valid versus invalid requests.

## Lookup product pricing

Retrieves the requested product’s pricing data from Google Sheets and checks whether a matching product record was found.

## Calculate and assess policy

Calculates quotation totals and margins, evaluates pricing rules, and decides whether manager approval is required.

## Prepare error responses

Handles lower-branch failure outcomes by preparing responses for invalid requests or missing product records.

## Auto-approved quotation delivery

Prepares quotations that do not require manager approval, logs them to Google Sheets, and emails the approved quotation to the customer.

## Manager approval request

Sends the approval request to the manager, waits for the manager’s response, and branches based on the approval decision.

## Manager-approved delivery

Prepares manager-approved quotation details, logs the approval, and emails the finalized quotation to the customer.

## Manager rejection handling

Prepares rejected quotation details, logs the rejection, and notifies the sales executive by email.

Dear {{ $('Prepare Final Quotation').item.json["Customer Name"] }},

Thank you for your inquiry. Please find your quotation details below:

Quotation ID: {{ $json["Quotation ID"] }}
Product: {{ $json["Product Name"] }}
Quantity: {{ $json["Quantity"] }}
Unit Price: PKR {{ $json["Unit Price"] }}
Discount: {{ $json["Discount (%)"] }}%
Total Quotation Amount: PKR {{ $json["Net Amount"] }}

Please contact our sales team if you require any clarification.

Best regards,
Sales Department

={{ `

Quotation Approval Required

Dear Manager,

A sales quotation requires your review and decision.

Customer: ${$('Verify Pricing Policy').item.json["Customer Name"]}

Product: ${$('Verify Pricing Policy').item.json.productName}

Quantity: ${$('Verify Pricing Policy').item.json.quantity}

Unit Price: PKR ${$('Verify Pricing Policy').item.json.unitPrice}

Discount: ${$('Verify Pricing Policy').item.json.proposedDiscount}%

Net Amount: PKR ${$('Verify Pricing Policy').item.json.netAmount}

Gross Margin: ${$('Verify Pricing Policy').item.json.grossMargin}%

Policy Status: ${$('Verify Pricing Policy').item.json.pricingPolicyStatus}

Approval Reasons: ${$('Verify Pricing Policy').item.json.approvalReasons.join(", ")}

Review & Submit Decision

Regards,
Sales Quotation Management System

` }}
